name: draw-diagram
description: Make editable draw.io diagrams offline: chip and system architecture, algorithm dataflow, state machines and timing laid out by the silicon-canvas engine; flowcharts, sequence, ER and other diagrams from Mermaid, PlantUML or XML. Checks the layout and renders PNG/SVG. Node 20+ only.

interface.shortDescription: Editable draw.io diagrams, laid out and checked offline.
interface.longDescription: Chip and system architecture, algorithm dataflow, state machines and timing traces are planned and laid out by a port of the silicon-canvas engine; other diagrams are written as Mermaid, PlantUML, CSV or draw.io XML. Produces .drawio files, checks them for overlaps and overflow, and renders PNG or SVG. Runs on Node 20+ without network access.
defaultPrompt: Draw the architecture of a GPU with four compute clusters, a shared L2 and HBM.
